metadata.description: Writing-quality tooling for coding agents: prevent AI-slop at generation time, detect and remediate it in existing text.

plugins.name: anti-slop
plugins.description: Prevents AI-slop patterns while drafting and remediates them in existing prose. Teaches what good writing IS (recipe-first) rather than shipping a banned-word list, and bundles a zero-dependency Node linter over 70 catalogued patterns with reliability tiers, stylometric texture detection, and a dedicated treatment of negative parallelism ("it's not X, it's Y").
